title: Number Bases: Conversion and Operations

standard_text: Convert numbers between base ten and other bases; add, subtract and multiply in other bases; solve problems on number bases. (summary of the NERDC SSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)

key_big: Each place is a power of the base
body_html:
How to think about it

  • To change to base ten, multiply each digit by its place value and add.
  • To change from base ten, divide by the base again and again and read the remainders from the bottom up.
  • To add or subtract in base b, carry or borrow b, not 10.

Examples

Example

Change 231₄ to base ten

2 × 16 + 3 × 4 + 1

Answer: 45

Example

Change 23 to base two

23 ÷ 2 … remainders 1, 1, 1, 0, 1

Answer: 10111₂

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Reading the remainders from the topRead them from the bottom up.
Carrying 10 in another baseCarry the base number.
Using a digit that is too bigBase 5 uses only 0 to 4.
